correctness.rationale: For k=q−1, there are qk vertices of each nonzero-diagonal type A and B and k strictly upper-triangular nonzero vertices C. The product coordinates (ad,ae+bf,cf) give A_t→B_{−t}, B→A,C and C→A,C with its own loop deleted. Those arcs prove strong connectivity, also at q=2. Independent contrasts within A and B slope fibers are killed, and the contrast on C is acted on by −I. On fiber constants the B-slope contrasts map isomorphically, by k times slope reversal, to the A-slope contrasts, which are killed. Since the decomposition into contrasts and constants is direct over C, this gives q−1 length-two zero blocks and 2q(q−2) length-one zero blocks. The remaining uniform quotient has rows (0,k,0), (qk,0,k), (qk,0,k−1); its polynomial is the stated cubic, with P(0)=−qk² and P(−1)=1−q. To verify simplicity independently of the discriminant expansion, for q≥4 use P(−2)=q(k²−4)>0 and the signs at −∞, −1 and +∞ to separate three roots. For q=3, P(−2)=0 and P′(−2)=4, so there is a positive value just to the right of −2 and the two other roots are separated by −1. For q=2, z³−2z−2 and 3z²−2 have no common zero. The nonzero spectrum contributes q+1 to every power rank and the length-two zero chains contribute q−1 only to rank A. An independent replay by exact triple enumeration, polynomial and power-rank calculations for q=2,3,5 gave (rank A, rank A², rank A³)=(4,3,3),(6,4,4),(10,6,6). The supplied checker and saved q=2,3,4,5 output were inspected but not executed; q=4 output is recorded evidence only. The invariant decomposition, not any finite replay, proves the universal result.
residual_risks: Neither Jordan multiplicities in the field characteristic nor adjacency with retained loops are covered.

value.rationale: This gives a complete invariant of a standard directed ring graph, not just a quotient spectrum or a small-order table. Despite quadratic vertex count and strong connectivity, the adjacency has linear rank, a quantified nonsemisimple part, and stabilization of rank at its second power. Knowing only the polynomial would miss that behavior. The formulas resolve such questions uniformly, including nonprime finite fields.
residual_risks: The conclusion is for the canonical two-by-two triangular ring family, not a general structural theorem for larger triangular matrix rings.
